name: Levi
overview: Levi is a male figure noted for his place in the lineage of the Messiah, as recorded in Luke 3:29. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about him. His significance primarily stems from his genealogical position within the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The name Levi appears once in the provided data with no specific meaning or divine origin indicated. It is presented simply as a proper name without further elaboration on its significance.
familyAndRelationships: According to Luke 3:29-30, Levi is identified as the son of Matthat and the father of Simeon. These family connections are explicitly noted in Scripture, providing a direct genealogical link within the Messiah's lineage.

While details about his life are limited, his presence in this genealogy affirms the historical and theological grounding of Christ's earthly heritage.
